description.en: An ultra-subminiature basic switch, 12.8 × 5.8 mm in plan, screwed down through two Ø2 mm holes 6.5 mm apart with M2 screws; used as an endstop. Either side face can bear on the bracket.
description.es: Un interruptor básico ultra subminiatura de 12.8 × 5.8 mm en planta, que se atornilla por dos barrenos de Ø2 mm a 6.5 mm entre sí con tornillos M2; se usa como final de carrera. Cualquiera de sus caras laterales puede apoyar en el soporte.
description.fr: Un interrupteur de base ultra-subminiature de 12,8 × 5,8 mm en plan, vissé par deux trous de Ø2 mm espacés de 6,5 mm avec des vis M2 ; utilisé comme fin de course. L'une ou l'autre face latérale peut s'appuyer sur le support.
description.pt: Um interruptor básico ultra-subminiatura de 12,8 × 5,8 mm em planta, aparafusado por dois furos de Ø2 mm a 6,5 mm um do outro com parafusos M2; usado como fim de curso. Qualquer das faces laterais pode apoiar no suporte.

sources.title: Omron D2F ultra subminiature basic switch datasheet
sources.supports: body 12.8 ±0.15 × 5.8 ±0.15 mm; 2-Ø2 (+0.12/0) mounting holes 6.5 ±0.15 apart; M2 mounting screws; pin plunger OP 5.5 ±0.3 mm; approx. 0.5 g (pin plunger)

frame_convention: Origin midway between the two mounting-hole centres, on the switch's mid-plane. +x runs along the 12.8 mm length through the two holes; +y through the 5.8 mm thickness, so side face A is at y = −2.9 and side face B at y = +2.9; +z toward the actuator (the actuator is pressed in −z).

operating_position.note: pin-plunger models, from the mounting-hole centreline

interfaces.note: The bracket bears on face A. Male: the M2 screws pass through the switch into the bracket. y = −2.9 is half the cited 5.8 mm thickness.
The bracket bears on face B.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The actuator (pin plunger, hinge lever or roller lever) is not a mating interface: what trips it is a motion, not a join. Its operating position is recorded for the pin-plunger model only.
